description: We are trying our level best to make something that we haven't made ever.
summary: AURA is an onboard, 100% offline Autonomous Flight Surgeon designed for deep-space exploration where Mars-to-Earth communication lags reach 40 minutes. Grounded in NASA-STD-3001, AURA delivers instant clinical triage and radiation abort guidance in 2 seconds.
details:
THE DEEP-SPACE MISSION PROBLEM

During long-duration crewed missions to the Moon and Mars, real-time telemedicine is fundamentally impossible. Radio communication blackouts occur during lunar orbital transits, while at Mars, one-way speed-of-light delays range from 4 to 24 minutes—meaning a round-trip medical consultation requires up to 48 minutes. In an acute medical crisis (such as Acute Radiation Syndrome from a Solar Particle Event or toxic cabin air buildup), astronauts cannot wait 40 minutes for Houston flight surgeons. NASA formally documents this critical capability gap as NASA ExMC Gap Med10: "We do not have the capability to provide computed clinical decision support in deep space during communication delays."

INTRODUCING AURA

AURA (Autonomous Universal Rescue & Astronaut-Health Agent) is an edge-native, zero-cloud clinical decision support platform built specifically to solve ExMC Gap Med10. Running entirely offline on spacecraft hardware (requiring under 8 GB of RAM), AURA transforms passive biometric and habitat telemetry into deterministic, flight-certified emergency action orders within two seconds.

CORE CAPABILITIES

1. Deterministic Safety Gating (NASA-STD-3001 Compliance): Continuously evaluates real-time vital streams (heart rate, SpO2, core body temperature) and environmental telemetry against hardcoded NASA-STD-3001 thresholds with zero hallucination risk.

2. Predictive Ingress Physics & Real-Time Shelter Abort: When an active Solar Particle Event (SPE) is detected, AURA calculates real-time dosimetric accumulation rates. If projected ingress dosage exceeds safe limits (250 mSv), AURA issues a mandatory abort order with exact countdown timings.

3. Ask AURA Voice Intercom (Air-Gapped Vector Retrieval): Astronauts report acute symptoms in plain English. AURA performs local, air-gapped vector search across certified NASA Clinical Practice Guidelines—synthesizing immediate, cited directives with zero cloud latency.

4. Hardware-Constrained Edge Architecture: Built with local quantized Small Language Models and in-memory cosine vector indexing, ensuring reliable performance even with zero GPU availability and complete network isolation.

ARCHITECTURE & TOOLS USED

• Frontend & Mission Control: Python 3.11 with Streamlit, avionics HUD theme, real-time timeline scrubbing, and checklist tracking.

• Clinical Decision Engine: Deterministic rule-based triage layer (engine/rules.py) enforcing hard boundaries for hypoxia, bradycardia, Acute Radiation Syndrome, and SMAC CO2 limits.

• Vector Knowledge Base: Offline vector search engine (engine/slm.py) embedding official NASA emergency medicine protocols using in-memory cosine similarity gating.

• Testing & Validation: Comprehensive test suite (tests/test_aura_core.py) verifying multi-stage sensor drift, dual-hazard escalation, and threshold invariants.
